title: OWASP Juice Shop
summary: Challenges from one to four stars, documented in a 54-page write-up.

card.caption: Forced browsing, SQLi, basket IDOR and negative quantities.

did: Forced browsing found unprotected hidden pages. Classic and UNION-based SQL injection gave an admin login and exposed user credentials.
results: Broken access control (basket IDOR, forged feedback) and weak input validation (negative basket quantities) rounded out the findings.
Client-side validation is easy to bypass with an HTTP proxy.
next: Add ownership checks on every API endpoint and validate number types and ranges on the server.

signal: proxy/WAF log: SQLi payload on POST /rest/user/login, quantity -100 on PUT /api/BasketItems
